learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge about the peculiarities in the organization and execution of projects
Application of the most important methods and tools for problem-solving in small group work
Ability to successfully handle new and complex tasks in a team

syllabus_topics: Project management, terms and definitions, principles of project work
Meeting Management, project phases, milestones and reviews
Project and schedule planning, cost and capacity planning, network planning technique, IT tools
Problem-solving techniques - work techniques, problem-solving cycle
Communication, teamwork, group development phases, conflict resolution
Ability to present and work systematically
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the written exam. Successful participation in the accompanying internship is a prerequisite for taking the exam.
bibliography: Schwarze, J.: Projektmanagement mit Netzplantechnik, 11. Aufl. nwb Verlag, 2016
Meier, H.: Internationales Projektmanagement Verlag neue Wirtschaftsbriefe (2015)
Burghardt, M.: Einführung in Projektmanagement – Definition, Planung, Kontrolle, Abschluss, 6. Aufl. Publicis Publishing Verlag (2013)
Kuster, J.; et al.: Handbuch Projektmanagement – Agil, klassisch, hybrid; 5. Auflage Springer Gabler (2022)
